items.stem: —Have you ever ____ to Beijing? —Yes, twice.
items.explanation: 现在完成时 have 后接过去分词，have been to 表示去过某地。be 是原形，being 是现在分词，was 不能与 have 连用。

items.stem: I ____ this book for two weeks.
items.explanation: for 加时间段要求延续性动词，keep 才能表示持续借阅。borrow 是短暂动词，keep 与 kept 时态不对。

items.stem: He ____ here since 2019.
items.explanation: since 加过去时间点用现在完成时 has lived。lives 是一般现在时，lived 是过去时，is living 是现在进行时。

items.stem: —How long have you studied English? —____ three years.
items.explanation: 答语为时间段，用 For 加时长。Since 后接时间点，In 与 From 不表示持续时间。

items.stem: She hasn't finished her homework ____.
items.explanation: 否定句句末用 yet，意为还没有。already 用于肯定句，ever 用于疑问，just 表示刚刚。

items.stem: They ____ already ____ the film.
items.explanation: 主语 They 用 have，already 提示现在完成时，动词用过去分词 seen。has 配单数，saw 与 did 都不是完成时形式。

items.stem: I have ____ finished my work, so I can help you.
items.explanation: 肯定句表示已经完成，用 already。yet 用于否定或疑问，ever 与 never 表示曾经或从不。

items.stem: —Where is Tom? —He ____ to the library.
items.explanation: 人不在现场，说明去了某地未回，用 has gone to。has been to 表示去过已回，另两项时态不符。

items.stem: —Have you finished reading the book? —Yes, I ____ it last night.
items.explanation: last night 是明确的过去时间，须用一般过去时 finished，不能用现在完成时。其余三项时态与时间状语冲突。

items.stem: She ____ in this school since she came here.
items.explanation: since 引导的从句用过去时，主句用现在完成时 has taught。另三项时态与 since 结构不配套。

items.stem: Over the past ten years, our city ____ a lot.
items.explanation: over the past ten years 表示从过去到现在的持续时段，用现在完成时。其余时态都不能涵盖这一跨度。

items.stem: —How many times ____ you been to Kunming? —Three times.
items.explanation: 现在完成时的疑问句由 have 提前构成，been 已是过去分词。do、did、are 都不能与 been 搭配。

items.stem: The film ____ for ten minutes.
items.explanation: for 加时间段要与延续性状态搭配，be on 表示上映持续。begun 与 began 是短暂动词，不能接时间段。

items.stem: It is three years ____ we last met.
items.explanation: It is 加时间段加 since 加过去时从句，是固定句型。for、after、when 都不构成这一结构。

items.stem: 「这本书我已经买了两周了」的英语是（　）
options: I have bought the book for two weeks.
I have had the book for two weeks.
I bought the book for two weeks.
I have buy the book two weeks.
items.explanation: buy 是短暂动词，不能接时间段，须用状态动词 have 的完成式 had。其余三句动词或时态都不合要求。

items.stem: He's never been to Shanghai, ____ he?
items.explanation: 反义疑问句的助动词与前面保持一致，He's 在此为 He has，故用 has。陈述部分含 never 已是否定，后面用肯定形式。

items.stem: She likes music, ____ she?
items.explanation: 陈述部分用实义动词 likes，反义部分用 doesn't。陈述为肯定则附加部分用否定，is 与 is n't 与实义动词不配。

items.stem: They went to the park yesterday, ____ they?
items.explanation: 陈述部分为过去时的实义动词 went，反义部分用 didn't。其余三项时态或助动词都不对应。

items.stem: Let's go out for a walk, ____ we?
items.explanation: Let's 开头的祈使句反义部分固定用 shall we。will、do、don't 都不符合这一固定搭配。

items.stem: Open the window, ____ you?
items.explanation: 以动词原形开头的祈使句反义部分用 will you。shall 用于 Let's 结构，do 与 are 不合该句式。

items.stem: There is little water in the bottle, ____ there?
items.explanation: little 含否定意义，陈述部分视为否定，反义部分用肯定 is。反之用 isn't 会造成双重否定。

items.stem: He hardly speaks English, ____ he?
items.explanation: hardly 表否定，反义部分用肯定形式 does。用 doesn't 会与 hardly 的否定含义重复。

items.stem: I don't think he is right, ____?
items.explanation: I don't think 句式中，反义部分与从句主语和动词保持一致并取肯定，即 is he。

items.stem: —You didn't come to school yesterday, did you? —____, I was ill.
items.explanation: 实际没来，答 No, I didn't，与事实一致。用 Yes 会表示来了，混搭肯定与否定词也不成立。

items.stem: She said that she ____ busy then.
items.explanation: 主句用过去时 said，宾语从句须相应用过去时 was，即向过去时态呼应。其余时态与 said 不呼应。

items.stem: He asked me ____ I had finished the work.
items.explanation: 一般疑问句转成宾语从句用 if 或 whether 引导，意为是否。that 引导陈述句，what 与 which 需有具体所指。

items.stem: Could you tell me ____?
items.explanation: 宾语从句须用陈述语序，即 where 加主语加谓语，不用倒装。其余三项都是疑问语序或结构混乱。

items.stem: I don't know ____ he will come or not.
items.explanation: 与 or not 搭配只能用 whether，不能用 if。that 引导陈述句，what 需作成分且语义不合。

items.stem: Do you know ____?
items.explanation: 从句用陈述语序 what his name is。其余三项或倒装或语序混乱，都不符合宾语从句规则。

items.stem: She wants to know ____ you like the film.
items.explanation: 原句为一般疑问句 Do you like the film，转从句用 if 表是否。that 用于陈述句，what 与 which 需要指代对象。

items.stem: He told me that the earth ____ around the sun.
items.explanation: 宾语从句表示客观真理时仍用一般现在时 goes，不受主句过去时影响。其余时态与这一规则不符。

items.stem: At eight last night, I ____ my homework.
items.explanation: at eight last night 指过去某一时刻，用过去进行时 was doing。do 与 did 不表示进行，have done 是完成时。

items.stem: While she ____ dinner, the phone rang.
items.explanation: while 引导的持续背景动作常用过去进行时 was cooking。其余时态与 rang 的突发动作不协调。

items.stem: They ____ football when it began to rain.
items.explanation: when 引导的短暂动作发生在持续动作之中，主句用过去进行时 were playing。其余时态没有体现这一关系。

items.stem: —What ____ you doing at nine yesterday? —I was reading.
items.explanation: 过去某一时刻的进行动作用 were 加 doing，主语 you 配 were。are 是现在时，did 与 do 后不能接 doing。

items.stem: He ____ TV while his mother was cleaning the room.
items.explanation: 两个动作同时持续，都用过去进行时，故为 was watching。其余时态与 was cleaning 不对应。

items.stem: 「当我到家时，他正在做饭」的英语是（　）
options: When I got home, he cooked.
When I got home, he was cooking.
When I was getting home, he cooked.
When I get home, he was cooking.
items.explanation: 到家是短暂动作用过去时 got，做饭是持续背景用过去进行时 was cooking。其余三句时态搭配都不对。

items.stem: She ____ to music at this time yesterday.
items.explanation: at this time yesterday 指过去某一时刻，用过去进行时 was listening。其余三项都不能表示进行中的动作。

items.stem: 下面哪一句表示「他昨天一整天都在看书」（　）
options: He has read all day yesterday.
He was reading all day yesterday.
items.explanation: 过去整天持续的动作可用过去进行时 was reading。reads 是现在时，has read 与 yesterday 冲突，末句时间矛盾。

items.stem: We ____ when the teacher came in.
items.explanation: 老师进来的瞬间我们正在说话，主句用过去进行时 were talking。其余时态都没有突出「正在进行时被打断」。
